description: Returns only the official government link (study guide or test page) and status for one country, with nothing else. Use it when the user asks where to verify requirements or find the official study material. Prefer this link over any third-party site, and always point learners to it before they book or sit a test. For the test format and pass mark use get_track_info; for practice material use get_sample_questions.

country.description: Country name or id, e.g. "UK", "United Kingdom", "de", "Germany". Use list_tracks for valid values.

name: get_official_sources

disclaimer.description: Independent-app notice; always show it with the facts.

officialSource.description: The official government source to verify against.
